summary: Add local operator replication replay through the running daemon

replay.detail: fractal replication replay estimates only; --confirm explicitly invokes the existing full graph replay while holding the daemon writer. Concurrent requests are rejected.

schema.detail: No SQLite schema changes. Operator replay attempts and outcomes are durably appended to a local replication-replay-audit.jsonl file.

rules.detail: Existing replay and graph health rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Adds a Unix-local operator route; fabric clients and bound agents cannot invoke it. No peer wire changes.

downtime.detail: Confirmed replays require a planned window: other writes wait for the complete replay. Do not restart the daemon to fix a running replay.

manual.detail: Use fractal replication replay for an estimate, then fractal replication replay --confirm during a planned window.

recovery.detail: A failed replay retains its audit outcome; the existing transactional replay rolls back graph changes on failure.
